notes: Assemblies of God church in the Canyon Del Oro / north Tucson area; address confirmed on the church's own location page as 2950 W. Lambert Ln, Tucson AZ 85742. Coordinates not set - run tools/geocode.py. Sunday School 9:00am, morning worship 10:15am, Wednesday programs 6:00pm. Distinct from The Canyon Church (formerly CDO Bible Church) on Oracle Rd. PASTOR CONFIRMED: the 'Our Team' page lists David Filener as Senior Pastor. The page also lists Lindsey Chavez (Children's and Youth Pastor) and Allan Chavez (Youth Pastor); their titles do not indicate regular Sunday preaching, so they are not recorded as preaching pastors - check the sermon list before adding either. SERMON HOST: the church posts full services on its own site, but the player is an embedded YouTube video - a sample service page embedded a video from the church's own channel @CDOassemblyofgod (channel id UC_BfXMvTs0SbcUXNmMkZK8A), so YouTube is the real corpus. The on-site sermon list is the easiest way to get dates and titles. Caption availability not tested. Whether individual videos name the preacher is still unknown.
